title: Return-Visit Rate on the Mechanical Road-Test Fee (Workmanship Warranties)
content:
**Clause.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the mechanical road-test fee in a mechanical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty is charged according to the remedy attempts completed on the coverage with the concern resolved, network reworks and outside-shop repairs alike: where one was completed less than the recent-visit months, 1 whole calendar month, before the charge date, the mechanical road-test fee is halved and rounded down to the whole dollar; where none was completed less than 1 month before but one was completed less than the return-visit months, 3 whole calendar months, before, the mechanical road-test fee is multiplied by the return-visit share of 0.75 and rounded to the cent; otherwise the mechanical road-test fee is charged in full.

| Most recent remedy attempt on the coverage completed resolved | Mechanical road-test fee as charged |
|---|---|
| less than 1 whole calendar month before the charge date | halved, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| none that recent, but one less than 3 whole calendar months before | multiplied by 0.75, rounded to the cent |
| none less than 3 whole calendar months before | in full |

## What counts

- Remedy attempts on the coverage completed with the concern resolved, whether network reworks or outside-shop repairs, for any concern on the coverage.
- Attempts completed not resolved do not count.

## Worked figures (hypothetical road-test fee of USD 99.60)

| Most recent resolved completion | Calculation | Fee as charged |
|---|---|---|
| 2 weeks before the charge date | USD 99.60 halved is USD 49.80, rounded down to the whole dollar | USD 49.00 |
| 2 whole months before | USD 99.60 multiplied by 0.75 is USD 74.70 | USD 74.70 |
| 5 whole months before | in full | USD 99.60 |
